about: Answer key for the seed data. matched_pairs are true matches the matcher should find. near_miss_pairs share category, colour and area but are different items - a matcher that links them is producing a false positive. Any lost/found combination not listed here is unrelated.
scoring_note: Strip the match_id field from the seed records before running the matcher, otherwise you are handing it the answer.

matched_pairs.item: Lenovo laptop backpack with torn front zip pocket
matched_pairs.why_hard: Colour given as black vs dark grey; finder states no brand and calls it only a heavy dark backpack.

matched_pairs.item: Steel water bottle, blue flip cap, 'Nitharsan' name sticker
matched_pairs.why_hard: Tamil lost report vs English found report; the name sticker is the decisive link and the brand is only on one side.

matched_pairs.item: Single gold-plated jhumka earring with a red stone
matched_pairs.why_hard: Tamil to Sinhala, no shared script at all. Both sides state it is one earring and not a pair.

matched_pairs.item: Gold rimmed progressive spectacles in a maroon hard case
matched_pairs.why_hard: Owner is unsure of the location; finder is specific. Maroon is written descriptively in Sinhala as dark red.

matched_pairs.item: Samsung Galaxy A34, cracked back, clear cover, child wallpaper
matched_pairs.why_hard: Deliberately easy. Brand, bus route, crack and wallpaper all agree, so this is a positive control - a matcher that misses this one is broken.

matched_pairs.item: Dark blue long umbrella, white edge piping, wooden handle
matched_pairs.why_hard: Found the next morning, so a same-day date window will drop it. Colour written as dark blue vs navy.

matched_pairs.item: Casio watch, silver strap, white dial, scratched glass
matched_pairs.why_hard: Brand appears in Tamil script as காசியோ, so brand matching needs transliteration rather than string equality.

matched_pairs.item: Brown leather bifold wallet with driving licence
matched_pairs.why_hard: The finder discloses the name on the licence, which the owner never mentions. A matcher must not read extra detail on one side as a contradiction.

matched_pairs.item: Three keys on a ring with black leather fob and brass bell
matched_pairs.why_hard: Lost and found venues are different places about 1.7km apart, because the owner walked between them. Exact-location matching fails here.

matched_pairs.item: Blue document folder with birth certificate and results sheets
matched_pairs.why_hard: Sinhala to English. Owner says folder, finder says plastic folder with certificates; only the contents tie them.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Key bunch lost and found at Maharagama market on the same day, hours apart.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: The lost bunch includes a Honda scooter key; the found bunch has no vehicle key and carries an LED torch.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Both blue Samsung phones at Panadura station within 40 minutes.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Lost phone had no cover and a chipped screen corner; the found one has a black silicone cover and an undamaged screen.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Handbag left in a three-wheeler and a handbag handed in by a three-wheeler driver, same area and hour, overlapping contents.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Maroon with a sling strap and reading glasses inside, versus black with no sling strap and no glasses.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Black wallet lost and found at Matara bus stand the same afternoon.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Bifold with NIC and a bank card, versus a velcro trifold with neither.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Thin gold chain with a broken fastening, same town, same morning.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: The owner describes a small Buddha pendant; the found chain has no pendant at all and weighs less.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Green outer garment left on a canteen chair at Kelaniya on the same day.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Hooded windcheater with earphones in the pocket, versus a knitted sweater with no hood, no zip, empty pockets.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Black umbrella lost and found at Moratuwa station.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Small three-fold with bank advertising printed on it, versus a plain long-handle umbrella, and a week apart.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Copper bottle with a screw cap left on a park bench, same park, 90 minutes apart.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Found bottle has an engraved Om symbol and is polished; the lost one has no markings and visible tarnish.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Black framed reading glasses lost and found at Nugegoda bus stand.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Thick frame with square lenses, versus a thin frame with round lenses, a cracked lens and a bent arm. Also a week apart.

near_miss_pairs.looks_similar_because: Blue document folder lost and found on the same campus within 40 minutes.
near_miss_pairs.ruled_out_by: Lost folder held a degree certificate and had a name label; the found folder holds commercial price lists and has no label.
